{
  "dataset_name": "car_evaluation",
  "model_family": "tree",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "total_cost_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of buying price and maintenance cost ordinals; higher means more expensive overall.",
      "value_range": [0, 6],
      "feature_family": "cost_aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows trees to split on overall affordability in a single threshold.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "buying + maint"
    },
    {
      "name": "cost_imbalance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute difference between buying and maintenance cost ordinals; captures mismatched pricing profiles.",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "cost_aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Trees can isolate cars where buying and maintenance diverge sharply.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(buying - maint)"
    },
    {
      "name": "utility_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Combined practical utility from passenger capacity, luggage capacity, and safety.",
      "value_range": [0, 6],
      "feature_family": "utility_aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Single split captures overall practicality of the vehicle.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "persons + lug_boot + safety"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_unsafe",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator that safety rating is at the lowest level (0).",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "safety_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Low safety is a strong disqualifier; explicit boolean aids tree splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(safety == 0, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_two_person",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator that the car only fits 2 persons (persons == 0).",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "capacity_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Two-person capacity is a major usability constraint; explicit flag accelerates tree splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(persons == 0, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_safety_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator that safety is rated at the top level (2).",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "safety_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "High safety often required for top evaluations; boolean simplifies splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(safety == 2, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "capacity_safety_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Product of persons and safety, capturing that both are needed for usability.",
      "value_range": [0, 4],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Nonlinear interaction; zero when either is absent, high when both are high.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "persons * safety"
    },
    {
      "name": "affordability_utility_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Utility score divided by (1 + total cost); higher means more utility per cost unit.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures value-for-money trade-off useful for ordinal evaluations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(persons + lug_boot + safety) / (1 + buying + maint)"
    },
    {
      "name": "expensive_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator that both buying and maintenance are in the top two cost tiers (>=2).",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "cost_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Identifies uniformly expensive cars in one boolean split.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((buying >= 2) & (maint >= 2), 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "premium_practical_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator that the car has high safety, can carry 4+ persons, and has a big boot.",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "utility_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures combinations associated with very good evaluations in a single feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((safety == 2) & (persons >= 1) & (lug_boot >= 1), 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "min_practical_dimension",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Minimum among persons, lug_boot, and safety; the weakest practical dimension dominates.",
      "value_range": [0, 2],
      "feature_family": "utility_aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Bottleneck logic: if any practical attribute is 0, overall usability is constrained.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.minimum(np.minimum(persons, lug_boot), safety)"
    },
    {
      "name": "overall_desirability_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic ordinal grouping of car desirability based on the combination of low cost, sufficient capacity, and safety. Encoded as 0=poor (unsafe or 2-person), 1=mediocre (adequate but expensive or unbalanced), 2=acceptable (balanced utility and cost), 3=excellent (low cost, high utility, high safety).",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "semantic_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a coarse ordinal bucket trees can split decisively without exploring many feature combinations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
